mechanics.claim: Shen dashes to the target location, dealing physical damage to enemy champions and monsters he passes through and taunting them.
mechanics.quote: dashes to the target location, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemy {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}} he passes through and {{tip|taunt|taunting}} them

mechanics.claim: The damage cannot hit the same enemy more than once, even if Flash ends the dash early and the end-of-dash collision still triggers.
mechanics.quote: This still cannot affect the same enemy more than once.

mechanics.claim: Dealing damage with Twilight Assault or Shadow Dash restores energy, but this restore can only occur once per cast of Shadow Dash.
mechanics.quote: The energy restore from ''Shadow Dash'' may only occur once.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown starts after the dash ends, not on cast.
Twilight Assault and Spirit's Refuge can be cast during the dash.
mechanics.quote: ''{{ai|Twilight Assault|Shen}} and {{ai|Spirit's Refuge|Shen}} can be cast during the dash.''
